mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for window sash replacement in San Bruno or South San Francisco?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for window sash replacement in areas like San Bruno or South San Francisco, look for experience with the specific type of sash replacement you need. Ensure they are licensed and insured, which protects you in case of any issues during the project. Check their references or reviews from previous clients to gauge their reliability and quality of work. A reputable contractor will provide clear, detailed estimates, explain the process thoroughly, and be transparent about timelines and materials. Don't hesitate to ask about their warranty on both materials and labor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with experience, good references, and clear estimates for window sash replacement in San Bruno or South San Francisco.
